The Opportunity: More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as one of their biggest financial commitments, yet managing one still means paperwork, phone holds, and switching between apps that don't talk to each other.

Jerry .ai"> Jerry .ai built the first app to manage it all — insurance shopping, refinancing, safety, and repairs — and since launching in 2019, we've grown to over 5M customers. Every one of those customers comes to us already looking for a policy, through our mobile or web app.

As an Inside Sales Representative , your job is to take that interest and turn it into a bound policy, matching each customer with the right coverage from one of Jerry 's 55+ carrier partners.

Who you are: You have 2+ years of experience as a top-performing sales agent You can multitask and manage multiple competing priorities You are passionate about helping others How you will make an impact: Respond to inbound calls from prospective customers for personal line auto, home, motorcycle, and other specialty insurance policies Educate customers on insurance policy details such as coverage and pricing Prepare and bind quotes through our carriers Effectively problem solve and objection handle to remove barriers from the customer purchasing the policy with Jerry Provide attentive, high energy conversation with customers that show we are actively engaged in finding a policy that best fits each individual's needs Compensation and perks: Hourly wage: $19.00 - 21.00 plus uncapped commissions (on target annual earnings: $100,000-$150,000+) We will pay for your P&C license (expected within 2 weeks after starting) Medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match Ability to work remotely (we provide work equipment) Ongoing training and mentorship from our leadership team An outstanding portfolio of insurance carriers and products - we work with over 55 carriers to ensure we can offer our customers the best options for them This role includes flexible scheduling options, with the choice between a 5-day, 8-hour schedule or a 4-day, 10-hour workweek.

Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits. About Jerry .ai Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s.

Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right.

That friend is Jerry . Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024.

About Starbridge Starbridge helps go-to-market teams win in the public sector. Government buyers signal their priorities constantly, in council meetings, budget documents, RFPs, and public records, but that intelligence is scattered across thousands of sources and impossible to track by hand.

Our platform surfaces those signals, connects them to the right buyers, and turns them into pipeline. We move fast, stay close to our customers, and are building the category. This is a chance to join early and shape how we scale. About the Role At Starbridge , we're redefining how companies win public sector deals.

Our innovative GTM intelligence platform empowers businesses to confidently approach and win more contracts in the State, Local, and Education (SLED) market—a $1.5 trillion space ripe for disruption.

Leveraging AI-driven insights, we provide our clients with an unfair advantage in identifying early buying signals, streamlining outbound strategies, and automating cumbersome processes. We're hiring a Founding Business Development Representative to help drive our explosive early-stage growth.

This isn't a typical BDR job—it's an opportunity to join a fast-moving, high-impact team where your work directly contributes to the company's trajectory. In just our first three weeks, we booked 249 demos. You'll play a critical role in scaling this momentum. What You'll Do:
Lead Initial Outreach: Own the first touchpoint with prospects, leveraging our proprietary AI-powered insights to engage highly qualified leads through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.
Accelerate Pipeline Growth: Work closely with the sales team to convert conversations into demos, constantly optimizing messaging and outreach strategies.
Build from Scratch: As an early member, you'll influence the playbook for our outbound motion, shaping best practices that will scale as we grow.
Sales Bootcamp: You'll receive personalized mentorship, structured sales training, and clear pathways toward becoming an Account Executive on an accelerated timeline. We expect you to learn quickly and move into a closing role.

High Earning Potential: Uncapped commission structure directly tied to your performance, rewarding your hustle and effectiveness.
Rapid Advancement: Structured career growth designed to move you quickly into a higher-level sales role.
Perks & Support: Meaningful equity options and comprehensive onboarding & sales training.

Proven BDR experience: Ideally 1-2 years of experience in outbound sales or business development. If you have a different background but possess grit, intelligence, and ambition, we're flexible. Convince us why you're the perfect fit.
Relentless & Competitive: You thrive in competitive environments and approach challenges with resilience. The idea of spending 5 hours per day making dials fills you with excitement.
Coachable & Ambitious: You actively seek feedback, apply learnings quickly, and aspire to advance into an AE role.
Bachelor’s Degree Required: Field of study less important than your drive and results-oriented mindset.
If you're energized by the idea of shaping a rapidly growing startup and accelerating your sales career in a supportive, dynamic team, we want to talk to you. Interview Process We move fast — really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed. All interviews are conducted via Google Meet. How We Work
Build Bridges to Help Customers Win - We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.
Shooting Star Speed - We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.
Fun Is a Feature - Fun is a Feature means we intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.
In the Arena - We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

M. Dodaj, comment s'est déroulé votre premier rendez-vous ce matin ?
Ma matinée s'est très bien passée. Le premier rendez-vous consistait à présenter le SIBIR à un important propriétaire immobilier. Ce fut une rencontre agréable, au cours de laquelle j'ai réussi à susciter l'intérêt du propriétaire pour SIBIR et à le convaincre de notre offre.
Quel rôle jouez-vous en tant que responsable régional des ventes chez SIBIR ?
En tant que responsable régional des ventes, je suis chargé de l'accompagnement complet et du soutien des clients professionnels et privés dans la région de Zurich et de la Suisse centrale.

Mon domaine de responsabilité ne se limite pas seulement à l'entretien des relations clients existantes, mais inclut également la tâche cruciale d'acquérir de nouveaux clients dans ma zone de compétence.

Cette double mission exige une approche globale afin de garantir que tant les clients actuels que potentiels bénéficient du meilleur service et conseil possible.
Avec quels départements travaillez-vous particulièrement en étroite collaboration ?
Dans mon travail quotidien, je collabore étroitement avec la planification du service et le service commercial interne. L'échange régulier avec ces départements est essentiel pour assurer un traitement sans accroc.

Tant dans la planification que dans le service commercial interne, des collègues expérimentés et professionnels travaillent ensemble pour offrir un service optimal à nos clients et répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Cette coopération étroite permet une coordination efficace des processus et garantit que nous pouvons répondre de manière flexible aux besoins de nos clients.
Quelles tendances observez-vous dans les produits SIBIR ?
Les produits SIBIR mettent clairement en avant les tendances de la Swissness, de l'élégance ainsi que d'un design simple et épuré. Ces éléments représentent une promesse de qualité. La focalisation sur la simplicité et l'épuration souligne non seulement la convivialité des produits, mais reflète également un design intemporel.

Ces tendances visent à garantir que les produits SIBIR ne soient pas seulement fonctionnels, mais aussi esthétiquement attrayants et en accord avec les normes élevées de la tradition de fabrication suisse.
Et dans le domaine du service toutes marques ?
Dans l'évolution actuelle du service toutes marques, des tendances claires se dégagent. Un souhait croissant des clients est de recevoir tous les services regroupés et fournis par un seul interlocuteur. La nécessité d'avoir un point de contact unique pour divers besoins prend de plus en plus d'importance.

Il est notable que le prix n'est souvent plus au centre des préoccupations. Les clients accordent plutôt une importance accrue à un traitement professionnel et efficace de leurs demandes, ce qui est considéré comme une valeur ajoutée.

Cela illustre un déplacement des considérations purement financières vers un accent renforcé sur la qualité globale du service et la simplicité du traitement.
Comment percevez-vous vos clients, qu'ils soient administrations ou particuliers ?
Mes expériences avec mes clients, qu'il s'agisse d'administrations ou de particuliers, sont globalement positives. Je suis heureux de pouvoir dire que j'entretiens des relations très agréables avec nos clients chez SIBIR.

La collaboration avec les administrations et les particuliers se déroule de manière positive, et j'apprécie la possibilité de contribuer à leur satisfaction. Je me réjouis de continuer à soutenir nos clients avec enthousiasme à l'avenir et de poursuivre ces expériences positives de collaboration.
Cela nécessite certainement des mesures de vente individuelles. Les développez-vous seul ?
Nous disposons de cadres très expérimentés qui nous soutiennent à un niveau élevé. Lors du développement des mesures de vente, il est toutefois important de noter que chaque client a des besoins différents. Il est donc indispensable d'être flexible et d'utiliser les mesures de vente appropriées au bon moment. Cela exige de chaque membre de l'équipe de la sensibilité et de la flexibilité.
Concernant la durabilité : comment pourrait-on économiser davantage de CO2 ?
Spécialement dans le contexte des appareils ménagers, je souhaite souligner les points suivants : prolongation de la durée de vie des appareils : la garantie des pièces détachées de SIBIR suit déjà une voie très positive avec nos clients. Pas moins de 70 % de tous les appareils sont réparés et non remplacés.

En favorisant une durée de vie plus longue et en garantissant la disponibilité des pièces détachées, nous contribuons activement à réduire l'empreinte écologique et à minimiser les émissions de CO2.

Ces approches durables sont non seulement en accord avec les objectifs environnementaux, mais démontrent également notre engagement commun pour un avenir respectueux des ressources.
La réparation des machines cassées a-t-elle aujourd'hui une plus grande importance ?
Absolument. Cette évolution est perceptible pour moi personnellement et je la perçois de manière positive. Une tendance claire se manifeste dans la préférence de nos clients pour les réparations plutôt que pour l'achat immédiat d'un nouvel appareil.

Cela souligne non seulement une conscience environnementale accrue, mais reflète également une valorisation croissante des pratiques durables. L'importance accrue accordée à la réparation des machines cassées se reflète donc non seulement dans ma perception personnelle, mais est également clairement soulignée par les préférences de notre clientèle.
Quel était votre métier de rêve enfant ?
Enfant, mon métier de rêve était policier. Mais au fil du temps, j'ai développé un fort intérêt pour une activité dans la vente. J'ai finalement pu réaliser ce rêve chez SIBIR.

At Ultralytics , we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models . If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.
🤝 Senior Business Development Representative

s.h: 🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
s.t:
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.
⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics , we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading YOLO models , we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.
Following our $30M Series A round , we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs in London, Madrid, and Shenzhen. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.
We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

This isn't an SDR role. It's an apprenticeship designed to turn you into an elite seller.
We don't hire people to book meetings and disappear. We hire Senior BDR who own markets, build playbooks, and learn to close deals working shoulder-to-shoulder with experienced sellers. You'll own two strategic vertical markets end-to-end — research the territory, identify key accounts, build relationships, generate pipeline, and develop the repeatable motion that makes those verticals ours.
You'll be paired 1:1 with an Enterprise Account Executive who'll teach you how complex sales cycles actually move. This is for people who want to build something, own something, and become exceptional at commercial work.
Reporting to the VP of Sales & Success, this role is based in our London office.

Own your markets
Own vertical markets. You're the CEO of your territory. Research accounts, identify decision-makers, understand buying patterns, and figure out how to reach them. You'll design the motion and run it.
Generate qualified pipeline. Build account lists, run outbound campaigns, attend industry events, and create opportunities where none existed. Success is measured by pipeline generated and deals closed.
Lead on messaging. Develop the narrative that resonates in your verticals. You're building the script, not executing someone else's.
Work deals & build the playbook
Work deals alongside an Enterprise AE. Shadow their calls, see how they navigate complex organizations, and eventually lead discovery, presentations, and parts of the sales process yourself.
Build the playbook. Document what works. Turn your territory knowledge into a repeatable motion that scales.
What success looks like
3 months: Deep understanding of your verticals, consistent outbound motion running, shadowing your paired AE on deals.
6 months: Qualified pipeline generated, leading discovery calls, contributing meaningfully to deals.
9 months: Verticals producing consistent pipeline, leading full discovery independently, closing smaller deals.
12 months: Promotion-ready with proven ability to generate pipeline and close deals.

Commercially sharp. You understand how businesses buy and how deals get done. You can have a commercial conversation with a VP without reading a script.
Relentlessly curious. You want to understand why buyers make decisions and what separates deals that close from deals that stall.
Willing to do the work. Cold calls, personalized outreach, attending events, documenting learnings — this requires discipline and consistency.
Determined to learn to close. You're here to become a great seller by working alongside people who've done it before.
Operate like a founder. You take ownership, make decisions without waiting for permission, and iterate quickly.
Technical enough. You don't need to code, but you need to understand how AI and computer vision solve real business problems.

Prior commercial or sales experience in an SDR/BDR capacity — internships, entrepreneurial ventures, or customer-facing roles count.
Existing knowledge of a specific vertical (manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, security, etc.).
Familiarity with AI, computer vision, or developer tooling.
Experience with outbound tooling — Sales Navigator, Apollo, Outreach, or similar.
🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.
Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.
See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.

s.h: Our culture is built around our core values
s.t:
Relentless progress: Constant evolution and improvement.
Strive for excellence: Perseverance and attention to detail.
Actions, not words: Focus on delivering meaningful results.
Act with urgency: Seize fleeting opportunities.
Open access to all: Transparent communication and collaboration.

We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.
Competitive base + variable: Tied to pipeline generated and closed deals sourced.
Equity packages: We want our success to be yours too.
Fast progression: Senior BDR → Mid-Market Account Executive within 12 months for strong performers. Two of our three current mid-market AEs started in entry-level roles.
On-site collaboration: Work with experienced sellers in our London hub.
Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.
Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.
Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.
Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.
Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.
👉 Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture, values, and teams.
🌎 Where and how you can work
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.
This role is based in our London hub on a hybrid basis.

s.t: We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen.

We're not just building models — we're building the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI.
Real ownership. You own two verticals end-to-end. You're measured by whether you win the market.
Apprenticeship model. Work 1:1 with an Enterprise AE closing large, complex deals. Learn by doing.
Product-market fit. YOLO is the most popular computer vision model in the world. Your job is to channel that demand into revenue.
Elite team. Work alongside experienced sellers who've built and scaled commercial teams.
If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment.

Die Stelle – auf den Punkt gebracht
Diese Stelle ist eine klassische Hunter\-Rolle. Ihre erste Aufgabe besteht nicht darin, ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio zu verwalten, sondern eines aufzubauen. Sie identifizieren Industrieunternehmen in Ihrer Region, die noch nicht mit CRIDEC zusammenarbeiten, öffnen Türen, bauen eine Pipeline neuer Kunden auf – und halten sie systematisch am Leben.
Wir handeln lieber vorausschauend, als Entwicklungen einfach hinzunehmen: Das ist einer unserer Werte – und genau das erwarten wir von unserer Verkaufsentwicklung. Nicht warten, bis der Markt zu uns kommt – ihn aktiv erschliessen.
Erobern – der der Stelle
Industrieunternehmen in der Region Mittelland, die noch keine Kunden sind, identifizieren und aktiv akquirieren.
Qualifizierte Termine vereinbaren, den Bedarf im Bereich Sonderabfallentsorgung erfassen und passende Lösungen entwickeln.
Abschliessen: Preise kalkulieren, Angebote erstellen – auch die komplexesten – und den Auftrag gewinnen.
Nachverfolgen – mit unnachgiebiger Disziplin
Jeden Kontakt aktiv pflegen: Bei uns ist ein Lead ohne Nachverfolgung ein verlorener Lead – und wir verlieren keine Leads.
Das CRM in Echtzeit pflegen: Jeder Besuch, jede Nachfassaktion, jede Gelegenheit wird erfasst.
Ihre Tätigkeit anhand von Kennzahlen steuern: qualifizierte Termine, Abschlussquote, Pipeline. Sie kennen sie, verfolgen sie und stehen dafür ein.
Repräsentieren
Das Gesicht von CRIDEC im Mittelland sein: Branchenanlässe, Partner, Verbände.
Eng mit dem Verkaufsteam zusammenarbeiten und sich auf unsere beiden Standorte Eclépens und Winterthur abstützen.
Was uns antreibt
Bei CRIDEC steht Schutz an erster Stelle: Das ist der eigentliche Sinn unserer Arbeit. Wir handeln lieber vorausschauend, als Entwicklungen hinzunehmen, halten unsere Versprechen auch dann ein, wenn es schwierig wird, und gehen den Weg gemeinsam, mit gegenseitiger Wertschätzung.

In dieser Position bekommen diese Werte eine ganz konkrete Bedeutung: Jedes einem Interessenten gegebene Versprechen wird eingehalten, jede angekündigte Nachfassaktion wird durchgeführt, und jeder gewonnene Kunde wird gut betreut.

About Linkup
Our Vision
We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.
AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.
Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.
Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.
Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.
Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.
Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

Cyber Security Software Sales Executive – North America Description -
HP Wolf Security and HP WXP help organizations protect devices, data and people while improving endpoint management and digital employee experience in today’s hybrid work environment.
We are looking for an experienced enterprise software seller with a strong cybersecurity background and a proven track record of winning complex security, endpoint management and digital employee experience opportunities across North America.
The Opportunity
As Cyber Security Software Sales Specialist for North America, you will lead enterprise and mid-market sales engagements for HP Wolf Security and HP WXP. You will build credibility with CISOs, security architects and senior IT leaders, combining strong commercial skills with a solid understanding of endpoint security, endpoint management, digital employee experience and enterprise buying processes.
You will own the full software sales cycle, from pipeline creation and discovery through solution mapping, commercial positioning, negotiation and close, while partnering closely with HP account teams, generalists and channel partners.

Drive software bookings, revenue growth and pipeline expansion for HP Wolf Security incorporating HP WXP across North America
Lead complex cybersecurity sales cycles from technical discovery and qualification through proposal, negotiation and close
Engage CISOs, security architects, endpoint engineering teams and senior IT stakeholders on security posture, risk reduction and endpoint resilience
Position HP Wolf Security and HP WXP across endpoint protection, hardware-enforced security, digital employee experience, endpoint management, Zero Trust, threat containment, application isolation, secure access and EDR/XDR-related discussions
Map customer security, endpoint management and digital employee experience requirements to HP Wolf Security and HP WXP capabilities and business value
Work closely with solution architects, technical pre-sales and product specialists to progress technically demanding HP Wolf Security opportunities and improve win rates
Support broader HP teams with repeatable sales plays, accurate forecasting and strong CRM discipline

Strong experience in enterprise software sales within cybersecurity, endpoint management or digital employee experience , with a record of delivering against quota in competitive markets
Proven track record selling security, endpoint management or digital employee experience solutions such as endpoint protection, threat prevention, Zero Trust, device security, EDR/XDR, digital employee experience, endpoint analytics, workplace experience platforms or related resilience solutions
Strong technical understanding of cybersecurity architecture, endpoint management and digital employee experience concepts , including endpoint security controls, attack surface reduction, isolation and containment, endpoint visibility, experience monitoring, identity and access concepts, detection and response workflows, and cloud-delivered software services
Experience selling to security leaders, IT operations teams, endpoint engineering teams, infrastructure leaders and procurement stakeholders within enterprise accounts
Ability to run effective discovery and technical qualification processes that uncover customer risk, security maturity, architectural requirements and business priorities
Ability to translate technical capabilities into clear business value for both technical and executive audiences
Strong sales discipline across solution mapping, business case development, forecasting and contract negotiation
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent commercial experience

Experience selling advanced endpoint security, device security, Zero Trust, EDR/XDR, endpoint management, digital employee experience, SaaS security or managed security solutions
Experience working with sales engineers, solution consultants or technical pre-sales teams in complex security sales cycles
Familiarity with enterprise security, endpoint management and digital employee experience frameworks, buyer evaluation criteria and competitive positioning
Experience enabling broader field teams and building scalable sales plays
Experience working with channel partners, resellers, MSSPs or strategic alliances in the cybersecurity market
A strong network of security and IT decision-makers across North America
Cross-Org Skills
Effective Communication — adapts messaging for internal sellers, technical buyers, and executive stakeholders
Results Orientation — drives software pipeline and revenue through a team-based selling model
Learning Agility — stays sharp in a fast-moving endpoint security market
Digital Fluency — comfortable with SaaS platforms, telemetry tools, and IT infrastructure concepts
Customer Centricity — leads with business outcomes, not product features
Impact & Scope
This specialist role directly impacts HP ’s software and services revenue across North America, operating as a force multiplier for HP ’s PC and device sellers. Success is measured not just by individual quota attainment, but by the breadth and quality of the specialist’s integration into the core account team’s selling motion.
The most successful specialists in this role operate with an ownership mentality, bringing the curiosity of a market analyst, the discipline of a business operator, and the influence of a trusted internal partner to everything they do across North America.
Complexity
Deals often involve multiple internal stakeholders, including PC sellers, channel partners and district managers, alongside customer decision-makers. Success in this role requires strong organizational navigation, proactive pipeline development and the ability to balance strategic territory management with in-flight opportunity support.
Why HP
Join a global technology leader with established customer relationships and a growing software and security business
Take on a role that combines commercial growth with cybersecurity and digital workplace innovation
Help customers secure devices, data and people while improving the employee experience in hybrid work environments

Entreprise de renommée internationale en pleine croissance, nous développons, fabriquons et commercialisons des instruments de chirurgie de haute technologie. Depuis de nombreuses années, inventivité, innovation, qualité de nos produits et services nous ont permis d'occuper une place enviable sur le marché international.
Pour soutenir notre croissance sur le **marché suisse**, nous recherchons un(e) :
**Clinical Sales Specialist**
**Vos missions principales :**
* Développer et piloter la stratégie commerciale sur l-ensemble du territoire suisse, en assurant la prospection de nouveaux comptes hospitaliers et cliniques ainsi que le développement et la fidélisation du portefeuille existant.
* Élaborer et négocier les offres commerciales, participer aux appels d-offres publics et privés et assurer les négociations avec les directions de blocs opératoires, les services achats et les départements biomédicaux.
* Accompagner les équipes médicales et soignantes dans la prise en main et l-utilisation optimale de nos équipements : démonstrations, essais, workshops et accompagnement au bloc opératoire.
* Représenter l-entreprise lors des congrès, salons et événements professionnels en Suisse.
* Analyser les évolutions du marché suisse des technologies médicales (MedTech) et identifier les besoins et attentes du terrain afin de contribuer au développement de nos produits et de transmettre les informations pertinentes à nos équipes R&D.
**Votre profil :**
* Formation commerciale ou médico-technique : ingénierie biomédicale, soins infirmiers, technicien(ne) en salle d-opération, management ou gestion des établissements de santé, ou formation équivalente.
* Expérience professionnelle de 3 à 5 ans minimum dans la vente de dispositifs médicaux, idéalement dans un environnement hospitalier ou chirurgical en Suisse.
* Une connaissance des domaines de l-ORL, de la neurochirurgie et/ou de la chirurgie du rachis constitue un atout.
* Excellente maîtrise du français et de l-allemand : l-une des deux langues doit être maîtrisée au niveau natif, tandis que l-autre doit être parfaitement maîtrisée à l-oral comme à l-écrit. La maîtrise du suisse allemand constitue un avantage supplémentaire.
* Excellent relationnel et aisance dans les environnements cliniques et hospitaliers.
* Autonomie, rigueur, esprit entrepreneurial, capacité à prendre des initiatives et forte orientation vers les solutions et la satisfaction client.
* Permis de conduire valide et disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents dans toute la Suisse.
**Ce que nous offrons :**
* Une culture d'entreprise conviviale favorisant les échanges directs et la communication ouverte.
* Un rôle clé où vos initiatives et vos résultats sont directement reconnus.
* Une contribution concrète au développement de l'entreprise sur le marché suisse.

**Ihr Aufgabenbereich**
Der Schwerpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit liegt klar auf der telefonischen Kontaktaufnahme mit potenziellen Investoren und Interessenten.
Sie sprechen aktiv neue Kontakte an, führen professionelle Erstgespräche, erkennen Interesse und Bedarf und qualifizieren die Kontakte für unsere Investmentberater und Partner. Dabei geht es nicht darum, komplexe Investments am Telefon abzuschliessen, sondern darum, Interesse zu wecken, Vertrauen aufzubauen und einen hochwertigen nächsten Gesprächstermin zu vereinbaren.
Sie arbeiten strukturiert mit unserem CRM, dokumentieren sämtliche Kontakte und Follow\-ups und entwickeln Interessenten konsequent vom Erstkontakt bis zum qualifizierten Lead weiter.
**Das bringen Sie mit**
1. Sie telefonieren gerne und viel und fühlen sich in einer vertriebsorientierten Call\-Center\- beziehungsweise Inside\-Sales\-Umgebung wohl.
2. Idealerweise verfügen Sie bereits über Erfahrung im Call Center, Telesales, Outbound Sales, Finanzvertrieb, Versicherungsvertrieb oder einer vergleichbaren telefonischen Vertriebsfunktion. Entscheidend ist für uns weniger Ihr bisheriger Titel als Ihre Fähigkeit, am Telefon schnell Zugang zu Menschen zu finden.
3. Sie bringen eine sehr gute Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch mit, treten selbstbewusst und verbindlich auf und lassen sich auch von einem Nein nicht aus der Ruhe bringen.
4. Sie arbeiten zielorientiert, haben Freude an messbaren Ergebnissen und verstehen, dass erfolgreicher Vertrieb aus Konsequenz, hoher Aktivität und professionellem Follow\-up entsteht.
5. Erfahrung im Bereich Investments oder Private Equity ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Die fachlichen Grundlagen vermitteln wir Ihnen.
6. Gute Französisch\- und Englischkenntnisse sind von großem Vorteil, um unsere Kunden in der Westschweiz und im internationalen Umfeld kompetent und auf Augenhöhe zu beraten.
**Was wir bieten**
Ein für vergleichbare Call\-Center\- und Telesales\-Positionen überdurchschnittliches Fixgehalt sowie eine zusätzliche attraktive, erfolgsabhängige Vergütung.
Sie arbeiten aus unserem modernen Office in Zürich in einem unternehmerischen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Zugang zu unseren Partnern und Investmentteams.
Sie erhalten eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in unsere Investmentprodukte, klare Leads und Prozesse sowie die Möglichkeit, sich bei entsprechender Leistung vom Lead Maker in weiterführende Sales\- und Investor\-Relations\-Funktionen zu entwickeln.
\*\*\*
Entscheidend für Ihren Erfolg bei uns ist nicht, wie lange Sie bereits im Private\-Equity\-Bereich tätig sind. Entscheidend ist, **ob Sie telefonieren können, konsequent dranbleiben und aus einem kalten Kontakt eine echte Opportunity entwickeln können.**
\*\*\*
Wenn Sie sich in dieser Beschreibung wiedererkennen und zu den Menschen gehören, die lieber zum Telefon greifen, als auf den nächsten Lead zu warten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit vollständigem Bewerbungsdossier (inkl. Foto) an:
